mapper.select: select id, username, password, real_name, phone, salary, role, remark, gender, age, address, member_level, create_time from sys_user
select * from sys_user where phone = #{phone} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into sys_user(username, password, real_name, phone, salary, role, remark, avatar, gender, age, address, member_level, create_time) values(#{username}, #{password}, #{realName}, #{phone}, #{salary}, #{role}, #{remark}, #{avatar}, #{gender}, #{age}, #{address}, #{memberLevel}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select count(*) from sys_user where role = 1
select count(*) from sys_user where role = 1 and username like concat(#{prefix}, '%')
select count(*) from sys_user where password = #{password}
select count(*) from sys_user where phone = #{phone}
